text:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — Apollo Health pilot just escalated to execs. Two blockers from their CTO: 1) on-prem connector throughput (reports 500ms+ tail latency for inference calls) and 2) pricing ask for a short-term reserved window during POC. Need an exec-level note by EOD and a plan for a temporary mitigation.

mike_se: Can you drop the top-level example request and any logs? I want to repro locally first.

sarah_sales: Copy of their trace (sanitized): `POST /v1/generate 200 512 tokens 520ms tail` — happens on bursts. They see it from a VM inside their VPC talking to our Private relay.

ankit_eng: Likely two causes: TCP warm-up + our default batching not kicking in for low concurrency. Short-term workaround: pin them to a small Dedicated pool with `min_replicas=2` and set `batch_window_ms=30`. That should shave the tail.

rachel_cs: CTO asked for an estimate on cost delta for that Dedicated window (2 GPUs, 48h) vs hosted. Need a ballpark to present at 10am exec sync.

jess_ops: I can run the cost calc. Quick question: do they require NVMe-backed cache for KV persistence? They said "local cache" but not specific.

sarah_sales: They want a "local cache" and low-latency routing. CTO also asked whether we can guarantee no egress to public internet during the window.

ankit_eng: We can do a Private deployment with restricted egress and our relay in their VPC. NVMe cache is optional; for 512-token typical length the perf delta is ~10-15% if we enable local NVMe.

mike_se: For the repro I pushed a tiny script to the infra-bot: 
```
infra-bot: trigger-load --target apollo-vpc --qps 5 --duration 600 --path /v1/generate
```
I'll attach perf traces in 20m.

jess_ops: Cost delta calc: 2xA10g for 48h + reserved infra premium = estimate "$4,200" for the window; hosted burst estimate ~$1,100. I'll finalize and share a breakdown.

rachel_cs: Ok — CTO wants a single slide that summarizes: mitigation (Dedicated 2x GPUs + batch/window tweak), security (VPC-only egress + SOC2 note), and cost/ask (ask our exec for a short-term discount vs list). I can draft.

sarah_sales: Thanks. Action items: @ankit_eng validate perf gain with `batch_window_ms=30` and NVMe toggle; @mike_se attach repro traces; @jess_ops publish cost breakdown; @rachel_cs draft slide for 10am. I'll ping execs after we have numbers.

infra-bot: Deployment test in progress — run id `deploy-1799012345-01`.

mike_se: Traces uploaded: https://redwood-internal/trace/1799012345 (sanitized). Tail latency reduces to ~130ms after batching change in my test.

ankit_eng: Confirmed locally: with `min_replicas=2` + `batch_window_ms=30` tail drops from 520ms -> ~140ms. NVMe gives another ~12% improvement.

jess_ops: Cost breakdown posted in the sales doc: https://redwood-internal/sales/apollo-poc/costs.pdf — short window ask w/ 10% discount would put net to ~$3,780.

rachel_cs: Draft slide uploaded to drive and shared with execs. Meeting set for tomorrow 10:00am PT — invited: Sarah, Head of Sales, CTO of Apollo, Engineering lead.

sarah_sales: Great. I'll prep a one-paragraph exec note for @head_of_sales highlighting the temporary mitigation and our proposed concession. Will share in 30m. :thumbsup:

jess_ops: I'll standby to schedule the dedicated pool once ops gets sign-off.

sarah_sales: Closing loop — thanks team. If we get sign-off we'll do canary rollout and keep the logging hook live.

mike_se: +1; will keep monitoring after canary.

infra-bot: Canary deployment scheduled — id `canary-1799012345-01`.
